scope: independently authored synthetic confirmation; not human or field data

cases.input: Write a Python LRUCache class with a max size and a per-entry TTL in seconds. Include pytest tests covering eviction order and expiry.
My Python function add_item(item, bucket=[]) keeps returning items from earlier calls. Why does this happen and how should I fix it?
Implement a token bucket rate limiter in Python that allows N requests per second with a configurable burst size, plus unit tests for refill timing.
My Python binary_search returns -1 whenever the target is the last element. It uses lo=0, hi=len(a)-1 and while lo < hi. Find the off-by-one and fix it.
Write a Python function that parses nginx access log lines with a compiled regex into a dict of ip, method, path, status and bytes. Add tests for malformed lines.
Add __post_init__ validation to my Python Money dataclass so negative amounts and unknown currency codes raise ValueError. Include pytest cases for both.
My Python memoize decorator crashes with TypeError: unhashable type: 'list' when the wrapped function takes list arguments. Make it handle lists and dicts safely.
Rewrite my recursive Python function that sums values over a deep tree of Node objects to use an explicit stack; it raises RecursionError around depth 1000.
Our Python metrics counter loses increments when called from multiple threads. Make it thread-safe with threading.Lock and write a test that exercises 50 threads.
Write a Python context manager temp_env(**vars) that sets os.environ entries and restores the originals on exit, even if the block raises. Tests included.
How do I unit test my Python send_invoice() function without hitting the real Stripe client? Show a unittest.mock patch approach and assert the call arguments.
Implement topological sort in Python for a dict mapping each task to its prerequisite tasks, raising a clear error that names the cycle if one exists.
Write a Python function computing Levenshtein distance between two strings with dynamic programming, and a helper that picks the closest match from a candidate list.
My pytest assertion assert total == 0.3 fails for 0.1 + 0.2 in my Python pricing module. What is the right way to assert on float results here?
Write Hypothesis property-based tests in Python for my to_roman and from_roman functions so round-tripping every integer from 1 to 3999 is covered.
Given a list of (start, end) integer tuples in Python, merge overlapping intervals and return them sorted. Cover touching intervals and empty input in tests.
Rewrite my Dockerfile for a Flask app so it creates an unprivileged user, chowns /app to it, and runs the process as that user instead of root.
My Python image reinstalls every dependency on each code change. Reorder the Dockerfile so requirements.txt is copied and pip installed before the source for layer caching.
Our container ignores SIGTERM and takes 10s to stop. Fix the Dockerfile ENTRYPOINT and CMD so uvicorn runs as PID 1 in exec form and receives signals directly.
Write a docker-compose.yml for a Django app and Postgres where credentials come from a .env file via ${VAR} substitution and env_file, with no hardcoded secrets.
Create a Compose file with two networks so the nginx proxy can reach the API service but the database is only reachable from the API container.
Add Compose profiles so pgadmin and mailhog only start when I pass --profile debug, while the app and database start by default. Show the YAML.

Write a HorizontalPodAutoscaler manifest for the deployment named api that scales between 2 and 10 replicas at 70% average CPU utilization.
Give me a Kubernetes Ingress for host shop.example.com routing /api to the backend service on 8000 and / to the frontend on 80, with TLS from secret shop-tls.
Show a Kubernetes Secret manifest holding DATABASE_URL and the Deployment env snippet that injects it with secretKeyRef instead of a plain value.
Write a Kubernetes Job manifest that runs alembic upgrade head once using our api image, with backoffLimit 3 and ttlSecondsAfterFinished set to 600.
Add CPU and memory requests and limits to this Deployment spec for a Celery worker: request 250m and 256Mi, limit 1 CPU and 1Gi. Return the updated YAML.
In my Helm chart, make the Service template switch between ClusterIP and LoadBalancer from values.service.type, and only render nodePort when NodePort is chosen.
Write a _helpers.tpl for my Helm chart defining a fullname template and a standard labels block, then show how the Deployment template includes them.
Add the Bitnami Redis chart as a dependency in my Chart.yaml with a condition so it can be disabled, and show how to set its auth password from values.yaml.
Create a Helm pre-install and pre-upgrade hook Job template that seeds the database, with a hook-delete-policy so finished hook pods get cleaned up.
We need clients to safely repeat POST /payments. Design how idempotency keys are scoped, stored and expired, and what a replayed request should return. No code.
Propose an architecture for feature flags across web, mobile and backend: where rules live, how clients evaluate them, and how stale flags get retired. Design only.
Compare shared-schema tenant_id rows, schema-per-tenant and database-per-tenant for our B2B SaaS and recommend one with the trade-offs. Discussion, not code.
Should order history be event-sourced or kept as mutable rows plus a history table? Lay out the trade-offs for a team of four and recommend an approach. No code.
Design the flow for user document uploads up to 2GB: presigned URLs, virus scanning, metadata persistence and failure handling. Components and responsibilities only.
Design the component boundaries for a notification service: template rendering, user preference checks, channel dispatch and delivery tracking. Who owns which data?
Our checkout spans payment, inventory and shipping services. Design a saga with compensating actions and weigh orchestration against choreography for this case. No code.
How should we model a product category tree up to 8 levels deep in Postgres: adjacency list, nested sets, closure table or ltree? Recommend and justify the schema design.
Sketch the repository interface our domain layer should depend on for Orders so we can swap Postgres for DynamoDB later. Method contracts only, no implementation.
Define the state machine for a subscription lifecycle: trial, active, past_due, paused, cancelled. List states, allowed transitions, triggers and invariants. Design only.
Our ingestion service gets sensor events faster than it can persist them. Design a backpressure strategy: where to buffer, when to shed load, how producers slow down.
Plan a zero-downtime way to split users.full_name into first and last name columns on our running service. Expand/contract steps and rollout order, not SQL.
Design how soft deletion should work across our API, database and search index: deleted_at vs tombstone table, visibility rules, restore flow and purge policy.
Design an audit trail for admin actions: what to capture, how records stay tamper-evident, retention, and how writes stay off the hot request path. No code.
Design how to prevent double-booking of rooms in our scheduling system under concurrent requests: locking vs unique constraints vs timed holds. Design only.
Design the public surface of our Python SDK: client construction, auth injection, sync/async parity and resource naming. Contracts only, no implementation.
Write a Spring Boot REST controller in Java with Lombok DTOs for creating and listing customers, backed by a JPA repository.
